stories.title: Pedestrian struck and killed by vehicle in Midtown Anchorage
stories.summary: Police said the person was hit Wednesday night on East Benson Boulevard between Denali Street and the Seward Highway by a driver who stayed at the scene.

stories.title: Peltola’s focus on affordability powered U.S. Senate win while Trump-aligned Sullivan floundered, observers say
stories.summary: Alaska voters focused on the cost of living and Sullivan’s support of Trump’s policies, rather than allegations about ballot-stacking and Peltola’s treatment of staffers.

stories.title: Senate rejects resolution to block Trump from striking Iran
stories.summary: Three Republicans joined Democrats in voting for the war powers resolution, which failed 51-48.

stories.title: Peltola will be first Alaska Native to serve in U.S. Senate, a milestone hailed by leaders
stories.summary: Peltola will be one of the first two Indigenous women in the U.S. Senate, alongside Minnesota Democrat Peggy Flanagan.

stories.title: Mississippi saw a spike in ‘inactive’ voters for the midterms. Democrats want answers.
stories.summary: There was an increase of about 60,000 since the presidential election two years ago.

stories.title: Kushner says Russia is ‘comfortable’ with NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine to end war
stories.summary: Recent Ukrainian strikes on Russia seemed calculated to embarrass Putin as he met in China with President Xi Jinping and Trump.

stories.title: Senate Republicans resist Trump’s bid to bypass Democrats on defense funding
stories.summary: Senate Majority Leader John Thune said the GOP would attempt to negotiate a deal to pass the spending package.

stories.title: This runner has completed over 70 marathons. This year, she ran 7 of them while pregnant.
stories.summary: Deirdre Keane’s passion for running was inspired by her father, an avid marathon runner who continued running even while battling cancer.

stories.title: Unlocked cells. Family dinners. A once-violent prison is trying something new.
stories.summary: The facility in Minnesota is scheduled to close after the death of a guard, a hostage situation and a riot in recent years. But a bold new experiment has inmates and guards fighting to keep it open.

stories.title: Anthropic launches biggest IPO on record despite the many fears surrounding AI
stories.summary: Shares began trading at $111.50, spiking more than 30% above the initial public offering price before closing at $97.17.

stories.title: Cincinnati Zoo says Fiona the hippo has died, days after ingesting a visitor’s hat
stories.summary: Before she died, veterinarians had been keeping her hydrated, giving her treats and monitoring her every move.

stories.title: IQ tests were built for an earlier era. See new science on what makes kids smart.
stories.summary: Now researchers are racing to measure the skills necessary for the future.
